Inspiring Stories: Features celebrated narratives including the Dashavatara, the life and teachings of Lord Krishna, the story of Prahlada, and Dhruva Maharaj.

Clear & Legible: Printed on high-quality paper with clear typography for effortless daily recitation (svadhyaya) and study.

Sacred Addition to Your Altar: An essential scripture for spiritual seekers, home libraries, temples, and auspicious gift-giving.

Enhance your spiritual journey and invite peace, devotion, and divine knowledge into your home with this sacred edition.

Authentic & Comprehensive: Features clear verse translations and insightful commentary detailing the journey of Lord Rama, Mata Sita, Lakshmana, and Lord Hanuman.

products.name: Viveka Chudamani
products.short_desc: A timeless Advaita Vedanta classic by Adi Shankaracharya, Viveka Chudamani ("Crest-Jewel of Discrimination") guides the seeker on discerning the eternal Self from the transient world to achieve spiritual liberation.
products.long_desc:
Viveka Chudamani (literally translated as the Crest-Jewel of Discrimination) is one of the most celebrated philosophical treatises written by the 8th-century master Adi Shankaracharya.

Written in lucid Sanskrit verse, this foundational text of Advaita Vedanta serves as a step-by-step masterclass on the path to self-realization (Moksha). It delves deeply into the core inquiry of Vedanta—teaching the seeker how to discriminate between Viveka (the real/eternal Self, Atman) and Anitya (the unreal/ephemeral nature of the material world).

Key Highlights:

Master-Disciple Dialogue: Framed as an illuminating dialogue between an enlightened Guru and a sincere seeker desiring liberation.

Core Vedantic Concepts: Provides deep exposition on the Pancha Koshas (five sheaths of human existence), the nature of the Atman, and the illusion of Maya.

Practical Spiritual Guidance: Offers practical insight into cultivate essential qualities like detachment (Vairagya), inner discipline, and profound meditation.

Ideal for daily study, contemplation, and anyone seeking a clearer, authentic understanding of non-dual spiritual wisdom.

products.name: Gita
products.short_desc: Discover the timeless wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita, a profound spiritual classic offering guidance on duty, righteousness, self-realization, and devotion. Perfect for daily reflection and spiritual growth.
products.long_desc:
Immerse yourself in the eternal teachings of the Sacred Bhagavad Gita, one of the most revered spiritual texts of ancient Indian philosophy. Set on the battlefield of Kurukshetra, this divine dialogue between Lord Krishna and Arjuna addresses fundamental questions about human life, duty (dharma), action without attachment (karma yoga), and spiritual devotion (bhakti).

Featuring clear text and durable binding, this edition serves as an ideal guide for both daily reading and deep study. Whether you are seeking clarity during times of conflict, exploring spiritual philosophy, or gifting a meaningful keepsake to a loved one, this sacred scripture brings peace, clarity, and inspired wisdom into any home.

Wearing or chanting with a Sphatik mala helps align your mind, reduce stress, and dispel negative energies surrounding your aura.
